title: Daily Intelligence Brief - May 23, 2026
summary: Six concurrent accountability threads in the May 20-23 window. ETHI committee report demands forced PM divestiture within 60 days of taking office (Carney's screen covers 100+ Brookfield-tied entities; Liberals dissented). Special joint MAID committee wrapping final hearings ahead of Oct 2, 2026 deadline on the mental-illness expansion; psychiatry chairs at every Canadian medical school oppose; Toronto plaintiff Brosseau filed Charter challenge. Ontario Superior Court stayed CFNIS-investigated sexual-assault charges, judge finding 'wilful police misconduct' - direct precedent for personal CFNIS filings. AG Hogan: $6.5B First Nations funding disbursed with no outcomes tracking; 149,000 IRCC-flagged students never investigated. Crown corporation flagged U.S.-routed artillery propellants destined for Israel; 164 military export permits still active; NDP closing bill failed (15 Liberals broke ranks). Bill C-9 passed House 188-144 and is in Senate; CCLA warns it threatens the rights of every Canadian.
